hook: Bones found in yard linked to missing women case

sections.voiceover: Investigators are searching a Chew Avenue home in Olney linked to 7 missing women's cases.
The Philadelphia Police Department and FBI recovered bones from the yard of the Chew Avenue property. Will the human DNA found at this Olney house of horrors identify the 7 missing women?
Investigators used luminol at the Chew Avenue home and confirmed human DNA inside the residence.
The Medical Examiner's Office recovered 1 bone during the second of 2 total property searches.
The Philadelphia Police Department and FBI continue investigating the Chew Avenue home for more evidence.
